hazards.title: Vault: registerApp is gone forever - no new pool manager or app, ever
CLPoolManagerOwner: after renounce the manager is pausable by an Ops key and UNPAUSABLE by anyone (worse than losing both)
BinPoolManagerOwner: after renounce the manager is pausable by an Ops key and UNPAUSABLE by anyone (worse than losing both)
RevShareHook 0x23CE: global unpause and setGuardian gone; guardian can still pause; revert is NotGuardianOrOwner (not the OZ error)
UniversalRouter: renounced while unpaused -> pause/unpause gone (a router renounced while paused is bricked forever)
UniversalRouter renounced while paused: permanently unusable (users must route around it)
CLProtocolFeeController (not installed): renounce is live; the contract becomes permanently unconfigurable
BinProtocolFeeController (not installed): renounce is live; the contract becomes permanently unconfigurable
Descriptor: renounce is live (owner = policy timelock); metadata URI frozen forever (cosmetic)
Create3Factory (owner = ops key): renounce is live; whitelist frozen (the ops key stays whitelisted)

notes.text: Contracts with no renounceOwnership at all: LatchTimelock x2 (AccessControl, self-administered), LatchRegistry (renounceRole(admin) refused - tested in phase registry), LatchLaunchRegistry, LaunchpadKit, LaunchGuardHook, CL/Bin quoters and position managers.
